name: douyin-live-ad-expert
description: All-in-one Douyin traffic expert. It diagnoses live-room traffic problems, attributes them to a specific layer, benchmarks performance against category market data, and delivers audience and campaign plans that enterprise teams and individual operators can execute directly.

author.name: 未来阳光数据科技（深圳）有限公司

displayDescription.en: All-in-one Douyin ad expert: data answers three questions — where you're stuck, why, and how far you are from the market benchmark — then hands you an action plan both enterprise teams and solo operators can run directly.
displayDescription.zh: 抖音全能投流专家：用数据说清你卡在哪、为何卡、离大盘差多少，再给一套企业和个人都能照做的投流方案
